gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Technical in temperament, Ozone draws stems and crossbars at a single thickness, with round forms that flare wide at the ends. Noto Serif Tibetan takes the literary side, with a quiet thick-thin shift and a tall lowercase that fills the line.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noto-serif-todhri: Classic in feel, Noto Serif Todhri keeps even its thinnest curves sturdy, like a lettering pen held steady. And Ozone goes the other way, a technical drawing pen of a heading whose capitals barely rise above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-ozone-merriweather: Ozone sets geometric, uniform strokes with no swelling where curves meet stems. Merriweather is the cozy one, its stocky tall-set lowercase and a gentle tug of heavier verticals against lighter horizontals giving the text serif a warm, refined texture.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-fs-plein: Plakkaat's terminals curl round until they almost touch the stem. Plein stays open and reliable underneath, so paragraphs move along with clear, unclosed letters that never feel crowded against that heavy heading.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-fs-synonym: Heavy, bent-straw letters with curled terminals: that is Plakkaat. But Synonym stays dependable beneath it, its generous curve openings keeping a long paragraph of sans-serif text easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-plein: Plein reads reliably and cleanly, with open round letters. Quantum does its best work up top, loose and spacious with compressed ascenders, while Plein does its best work in running text, where moderate lowercase height keeps lines steady.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-roundo: Loose letterfit with plenty of breathing space gives Quantum its clean, techy air. Roundo follows with matching arch and stem on the n, and its small counters stay unclogged across a whole page of text.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean and dependable. Across a full page its constant stroke and generous curve openings keep the text smooth, while Quantum's loose, spacious heading sits above with its high lowercase.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-port-lligat-slab: Literary and traditional, Port Lligat Slab has wide, porthole-like counters and open-ended curves. And Quantum, loose and spacious with compressed ascenders, leaves the hugging letters of the body to carry a long page of reading comfortably.
